scope: Small physical-control pilot: symmetric relaxation/exchange/relaxation path, whole-path MH, on the existing v1 target. No learned controller.
per_cycle: One supported multiscale MALA update, one uniformly selected exchange with four ULA steps before and after it, one supported multiscale MALA update.
intermediate_support: Smooth even eSEN plus restraint on COM coordinates; no intermediate chemical support claim. Both raw inversion orientations scored at every path vertex, including unsupported endpoints.
acceptance: Endpoint target difference + intrinsic exchange log Jacobian + reverse/forward action log ratio + every reverse/forward Gaussian propagation log ratio. Reject unsupported endpoints and missing reverse actions.
stop_rule: Complete both bounded arms, audit every intermediate query and random stream. No scale-up or learned-path claim from per-attempt acceptance alone. Neither a negative short pilot nor a positive endpoint proves equilibrium or universal success/failure.
